
# Leather Cover R

Official website:
https://remonking56-rgb.github.io/leathercoverr/

Brand: Leather Cover R
Market: Egypt
Languages: Arabic and English

## About the brand

Leather Cover R presents a classic leather shoe with interchangeable exterior covers.

The concept allows customers to change the external color and appearance of their shoe while keeping the original base shoe and sole.

## Product features

- Classic leather shoe, not a sneaker.
- Interchangeable exterior covers.
- Multiple color options.
- One base shoe with multiple looks.
- The original shoe sole remains unchanged.
- Custom color requests through the website.

## Product description in Arabic

Leather Cover R هو حذاء جلد كلاسيكي بفكرة مبتكرة تعتمد على كفرات خارجية قابلة للتبديل، لتغيير لون ومظهر الحذاء مع الاحتفاظ بالحذاء الأساسي والنعل الأصلي.
